speaker: Gordon
text: Gordon?Hello?Honey! Penny's sleeping!What do you even say? You can't just break into a woman's apartment in the middle of the night and clean!I had no choice. I couldn't sleep knowing that just outside my bedroom was our living room, and just outside our living room was that hallway, and immediately adjacent to that hallway was... this.Do you realize that if Penny wakes up, there is no reasonable explanation as to why we're here? I just gave you a reasonable explanation. Honey, you gave me an explanation. It's reasonable as will be determined by a jury of your peers.Don't be ridiculous. I have no peers. Honey, we have to get out of here.You might want to speak in a lower register. What? Evolution has made women sensitive to high-pitched noises while they sleep so that they'll be roused by a crying baby. If you want to avoid waking her, speak in a lower register.That's ridiculous.
